newsitem.title: USA: CIA chief says Iraqi tanks pulling back.
newsitem.headline: CIA chief says Iraqi tanks pulling back.

text.p: CIA Director John Deutch said on Thursday that Iraqi tanks were pulling back from the Arbil region of northern Iraq.
Deutch said that following U.S. cruise missile strikes against Iraq earlier this week, President Saddam Hussein's "motorized and tank units are withdrawing from Arbil and northern Kurdish" areas.
Deutch's was speaking during testimony on other issues to the Senate Intelligence Committee.
A Pentagon spokesman, Navy Lt. Cmdr. Scott Campbell, said earlier the situation around Arbil appeared to be quiet.

Denying reports that Iraq's forces were again preparing to move against Kurds in northern Iraq, Campbell said, "We don't see it happening. We don't see any attacks or massing of tanks in the area between Arbil and Sulaimaniya."
